9.1.3. qnav.earth.geoid

9.1.3.1. geoid.py

summary:

A module for interpolating geoid heights from presented geoid PGM files. This module provides classes and functions used to extract geoid information from given PGM encoded geoid files. The most common use for this module is for interpolating the geoid height at requested positions.

authors:
Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk
version:

1.0.0 - First full implementation of this module.

class qnav.earth.geoid.GeoidPGM(pgm_file: Path)[source]

A class for handling and managing reading the Geoid height information from a selected PGM (Pixel Gray Map) file and providing functionality for extracting required information from it. Methods for reading or interpolating the Geoid height at given coordinates, as well as visualising the loaded data are all contained within this class.

get_height(lat: float, lon: float) → float[source]

Interpolates geoid height for given latitude and longitude. For a single coordinate point, interpolates and returns the geoid elevation height in metres.

qnav.earth.geoid.read_pgm_data(pgm_file: Path, pgm_offset: float = -108, pgm_scale: float = 0.003) → ndarray[source]

Reads and returns the numerical contents of given PGM file. For a given PGM file, this function will read it and extract the Geoid height information (relative to the Earth’s Ellipsoid) from it. The returned matrix’s origin point’s coordinates will be [90, -180] with the last point’s coordinates being [-90, 180].

Parameters:

  • pgm_file (str or Path) – The location of the PGM file containing Geoid data.

  • pgm_offset (float) – (Optional) The offset values for the values within the PGM file as PGM values normally start from 0 (default = -108).

  • pgm_scale (float) – (Optional) The scale for the values within the PGM file as PGM values can only be integers (default = 0.003).

Returns:

A matrix containing the Geoid height (relative to the Earth’s Ellipsoid) for various locations along the earth.

Return type:

np.ndarray

qnav.earth.geoid.read_pgm_header(pgm_file: Path) → dict[source]

Returns values present in the header of a given PGM file. PGM files can contain comments which describe information such as the offset and scale values for the Geoid data they contain. For scenarios where the offset and scale are contained within these comments, this function will find and extract their values.

Parameters:

pgm_file (Path) – The location of the PGM file containing Geoid data.

Returns:

A dictionary containing the found offset and scale values (or None/Null if the values could not be found within the comments).

Return type:

dict
